title: Mini-game input polish: Space-mash skips the game-over card, jump on retry, no door hint, no get-ready
details: (Found in the 2026-09-26 code review, owner asked for all of these to be fixed) Game-over/win cards need a short input guard; platformer should not jump from the Space that confirmed Retry and should say "collect all cells first" at the door; the flyer needs a "get ready" beat before gravity starts. Number keys/wheel also change slots while menus are open.
